verdict.rationale: Skills are documented as plain directories containing a `SKILL.md` (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown) with optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ folders. Anthropic publishes this format as the open Agent Skills standard "for cross-platform portability" that "works across multiple AI tools." A hands-on probe installed an official skill with third-party tooling and no Anthropic account, and a community developer adapted the repo's skills to run on Gemini, while another user describes a skill as just a markdown and YAML file on the filesystem. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of a non-Claude harness loading a skill unmodified (the Gemini port required building a custom loader).
